name: n4_inventory_diff
description: Compare two inventory snapshots (n4_inventory_snapshot) by slot path; reads only the two local files (no station request, needs no session). a and b are snapshot names as the snapshot reply gives them, files under <state-dir>/exports/: a name with '..' or a path separator, or one that is not there, is refused. The reply lists added and removed components [{path, type}], changed slot values [{path, slot, before, after}] (null: the slot was not sent, at its default or absent), type_changed [{path, before, after}] and handle_changed (informational: a re-created component), each cut to limit items (truncated says one was), counts of every list before the cut plus unchanged, and notes when the two sides differ in station, subtree, recorded slots or contracts, or one was truncated. Read-only.
